scope: 110 distinct orderable ICs in three focused families: 76 analog, 28 power, and six Hall/angle sensors. One selected package per base IC; no voltage or value matrix expansion.
availabilityMethod: Exact manufacturer and SKU matched to a positive-stock distributor detail page, or the exact TLV9002IDR row in a distributor category listing. Search/index and retrieved page snapshots were checked on the stated date. They are offer evidence, not live checkout or a guarantee that inventory remains available. Stock of recommended substitutes was excluded. Retired IRS2110PBF and UCC28C43P package choices were replaced by active IRS2110STRPBF and UCC28C43DGKR.
drawingReview: ICs use component-side package views, pin 1 upper left and counterclockwise numbering. TO-220 regulators use an explicitly labeled front face with three actual leads; their native host footprints use the upright lead projection. Source pin diagrams containing unextractable graphics were rendered for inspection. Body markings are representative.
commonLimitations: Every footprint is FP:R: a reference package/host pattern with selected lands and drill values, not an audited production land pattern. Package lead pitch and terminal numbering were checked against the cited manufacturer material.
Every generated WRL model is 3D:A. A linked datasheet or other vendor document does not establish generated mechanical accuracy.
Commercial evidence is a dated retrieved listing snapshot; stock quantity and lead time may change.
Canvas drawings are enlarged package illustrations. Selected metal contact centers drive anchors and illustrated leads; native footprints are in millimeters.
